description: Lichess leaderboard for a single chess variant: the highest-rated Lichess accounts in one perf (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, correspondence, chess960, crazyhouse, atomic, antichess, horde, kingOfTheHill, racingKings, threeCheck, ultraBullet), up to 200 entries. Returns each player username, title, and current rating in that variant. Answers who the top-rated blitz or bullet players on Lichess are right now.
name: top_players
